note.question: Which contracting and organizational model best motivates processors and informal collectors to recover ocean-bound plastic while balancing firm profit, social benefit, and environmental impact?
note.overview: The focal firm moves first, the processor responds, and multiple collectors then choose effort; all decisions are connected through payoffs and the paper explicitly solves the sequential supply-chain outcome by backward induction.

components.label: Model sequence and system structure
components.explanation: In Case O (plastic offsets only), the focal firm first sets the offset price and per-unit bonuses to the processor and collectors; the processor then sets its acquisition price; collectors finally choose collection quantities. Cases S and OS replace or augment those first-stage terms with segregated-plastic sales and purchasing-contract decisions.
